pemb_note: Owner bid on 98 PEMB projects out of 393 total. PEMB bids are typically for the structural steel components (columns, beams, canopies, mezzanines) within a PEMB project, not the PEMB system itself. The bid scanner hard-disqualifies pure PEMB language per the Owner's rule: 'PEMB is not in scope. Full stop.' However, hybrid projects with conventional steel scope within a PEMB building should not be auto-rejected.
